verdict.rationale: incident.io documents on-call schedules, escalation paths, and paging, but the evidence never names the delivery channels (push, SMS, phone call, email) or any per-user, per-channel notification rules. Escalation-path rules for priority and working hours govern who gets paged, not how pages reach them, so they are adjacent and earn no credit. The Twilio number is for live call routing, not outbound paging.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules
